user.title: PC details
user.description: Enter the LAN IP and the NIC MAC address (required for Wake-on-LAN). The state check tries ping first, then the fallback TCP ports below.

data_description.broadcast_address: 255.255.255.255 works for a flat LAN; use the subnet broadcast for VLANs
data_description.boot_grace: The switch stays on for this long after you tap it, so the Home app tile does not bounce back
data_description.tcp_ports: Used when ping is blocked by a firewall, comma separated; leave empty to use ping only

shutdown.title: Shutdown
shutdown.description: Shutdown runs an OS command over SSH. Choose "Wake only" if you do not need it.

data_description.ssh_user: On Windows use a local administrator account, without a domain prefix
data_description.ssh_key: Path on the Home Assistant host, e.g. /config/.ssh/id_ed25519
data_description.custom_command: Leave empty for the default: shutdown /s /f /t 0 on Windows, pmset sleepnow on macOS (a Mac cannot be woken from a full shutdown)
